name: What permits are required for a whole home remodel in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for a whole home remodel in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Bay Area, a comprehensive whole home remodel typically requires multiple permits from your local building department, such as those in South San Francisco or Millbrae. These may include permits for building, electrical, plumbing, mechanical (HVAC), and sometimes specific permits for structural changes or historical district requirements. Our team handles the entire permitting process, ensuring all necessary approvals are secured before construction begins, which is crucial for compliance and avoiding delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Whole home remodels in the Bay Area require various permits, including building, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical. Our team manages the permitting process with local building departments.
